title: Ginger beef with greens
summary: Ginger beef with greens is a chinese dinner built around lean beef frying steak and pak choi, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Slice lean beef frying steak and pak choi before the pan is hot. Ginger beef with greens is a fast cook, so have the sauce measured too.
steps.tip: A crowded wok steams. Cook the protein in two batches if the pan looks full.

steps.instruction: If the dish includes a grain or noodles, start them now in salted water so they are ready when the stir-fry is.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry lean beef frying steak until just cooked. Scoop it onto a plate.

Fry the garlic and ginger, add pak choi and fresh root ginger, return lean beef frying steak, and toss with the sauce for a minute. Taste Ginger beef with greens before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
